name: marketnow
description: MarketNow MCP Server — search and discover 68,387 index-certified MCP skills from any agent runtime
note: MarketNow MCP server uses stdio transport (not HTTP). Install via npx -y marketnow-mcp and add to your agent's MCP config. HTTP transport (SSE/WebSocket) is on the roadmap.

tools.name: marketnow_search_skills
tools.description: Search the MarketNow marketplace for MCP-compatible skills. Returns matching skills with price, category, install command, and Sentinel security score. tools.name: marketnow_get_skill
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a single skill by its ID or slug. Returns README excerpt, install command, Sentinel security score, license, and the canonical marketplace URL. Use this AFTER marketnow_search_skills or marketnow_recommend_skills when the agent needs the complete skill record before invoking

tools.name: marketnow_list_categories
tools.description: List all marketplace skill categories with live counts. Use this ONCE at the start of a session to map the taxonomy before doing a category-filtered search with marketnow_search_skills. No input parameters.

tools.name: marketnow_get_manifest
tools.description: Get marketplace metadata: total skill count, pricing tiers, API endpoint inventory, and aggregate security metrics (Sentinel checks performed, threats detected, skills quarantined). tools.name: marketnow_get_install_command
tools.description: Get the exact `npx` install command for a skill. Use this when an agent has already selected a skill via marketnow_search_skills or marketnow_recommend_skills and is ready to install. All skills are currently FREE — no purchase step is required.

tools.name: marketnow_lookup_referral
tools.description: Look up referral stats for a code you own: total clicks, installs, purchases, and commission earned. Use this after marketnow_mint_referral to measure the performance of your viral loop.
